name: Athlete
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+ You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Climb Speed.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Hop Up.description: When you have the Prone condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

Jumping.description: You can make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.
